note:
stock: all 18 of its field hooks renamed for the field they serve, with a migration for the stored Python that names them.

Seven served several fields while named for one of them, so each takes a name held in common (§2.4.1): _compute_count_reordering_rules -> _compute_reordering_rules on product.product and product.template (count_reordering_rules, reordering_qty_min, reordering_qty_max), _compute_location_id -> _compute_locations on stock.move.line ALONE (location_id + location_dest_id; the same name on stock.move, stock.picking, stock.lot, stock.scrap and stock.warehouse.orderpoint serves one field each and is correct there), _compute_lead_days -> _compute_lead_time, _compute_products_availability -> _compute_availability_status, _compute_date_last_movement -> _compute_last_movement, _compute_is_partial_package -> _compute_partial_packages.

Six were free-standing domains that did not say so in front (ADR-0054): _quantity_search_domain, _get_accessible_location_domain, _get_allocatable_demand_domain, _get_resupply_pick_leg_domain, _get_extra_domain and _product_domain -> _get_domain_*.

Five were straight misnames the gate spelled out: _default_lot_sequence -> _default_lot_sequence_id, _has_product_selectable_route -> _default_has_available_route_ids, _compute_move_count -> _compute_count_move_ready, _inverse_inventory_quantity -> _inverse_inventory_quantity_auto_apply, _compute_action_message -> _compute_rule_message.

Four renames carry call sites outside stock, all of them overrides that would otherwise be left uncalled with no gate to say so: purchase_stock (_compute_lead_days), mrp (_get_extra_domain, _product_domain) and repair (_product_domain).

THE ANNASSIGN FIX IN THE GATE CANNOT REACH ANY OF THESE. stock, mrp, repair and purchase_stock contain zero annotated field declarations between them, so every field the pre-fix gate saw is every field there is and the classification of all 18 is version-independent.

  258 -> 241
